text:
maria: Quick heads-up — kicking off the marketplace seedpack for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need to validate asset bundle + entitlements before we push to publisher portal. Target: staging publish next Tue. I uploaded an initial manifest and a sketch of SKU mapping.

sam: Sounds good. Can you drop the manifest link and the trial SKU CSV here?

maria: s3://redwood-marketplace/seedpacks/1768012345/manifest.json
manifest snippet:
```
name: redwood-inference
version: 1.0.0
assets: [ami-0abc1234, gcp-image-123abc, azure-image-zzz999]
entitlements: {trial: true, seats: 1, telemetry: opt-in}
pricing: {base_monthly: 499.00, metered_tokens: true}
```

jia: Infra notes — we'll need a publisher service principal + explicit role mapping per cloud. For AWS use role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MarketplacePublisher. AMIs must be HVM and have the correct virtualization. Also need region mapping file (us-west-2, eu-west-1, asia-southeast1). I'll add a TF snippet to validate.
```
# sample TF (validation only)
resource "aws_ami" "marketplace" {
  id = "ami-0abc1234"
}
```

beth: Legal checklist: confirm pricing model (flat vs metered), trial length, telemetry/privacy language, and any BYOL/HSM entitlements. I need a CSV mapping SKU -> feature_flags -> pricing -> data_residency. Also provide EULA variants for EU/US. If there are export restrictions call them out.

maria: @beth noted — pricing plan is flat monthly + optional metered add-on for heavy usage. Trial = 14 days. Telemetry is opt-in by default. I'll upload the SKU CSV and EULA drafts by EOD.

onboard-bot: publisher-portal: listing created (id: pub-98765) — staging workspace assigned.

sam: :thumbsup: Marketplace requires logo (SVG) + 2x PNG (1024x1024 hero, 800x450 screenshot etc). Also two short screenshots and a 1-line summary and 300-word description. Can we include a short quickstart command?

maria: Uploading logos now. Quickstart (to show in listing):
```
# quickstart
curl -sS https://download.redwood.ai/install.sh | bash
redwoodctl deploy --provider aws --ami ami-0abc1234 --region us-west-2
```
Will include a 1-line and a 300-word blurb.

jia: For GCP we need the image in project redwood-marketplace-images and compute API enabled. I can run the validation pipeline if granted publisher access (needs roles: roles/compute.admin on the image project). Also note: if we rebuild AMIs for Nix support it could add ~2 days.

sam: I'll grant jia publisher role today. @beth once CSV is up can you do a prelim signoff? Also pinging infra SRE for the staging ingest window.

beth: I'll review the CSV tonight. Also flagging privacy: ensure telemetry opts and data retention windows are explicit. If we collect logs, need a toggle.

maria: Good call — adding a short privacy blurb: "No telemetry by default; optional telemetry with explicit opt-in and configurable retention."

sam: Plan for now: assets + CSV by EOD Fri, legal signoff Mon, run validation Mon-Tue, staging publish Tue during ingest window. Any blockers?

jia: If AMIs need rebuild for Nix support that’s the only blocker; call out now so we can schedule.

maria: Will flag immediately if build fails. Keeping the build pipeline green.

onboard-bot: reminder: marketplace ingest window scheduled Fri 18:00 UTC — ensure artifacts are in staging before then.

beth: :eyes: aiming for Monday signoff if CSV/upload looks clean.

sam: Thanks team — tracking this on the marketplace board. @maria drop final links to the manifest, CSV, and EULA drafts in this thread when ready.

maria: Will do. Thanks everyone :rocket:
